name: MonarchAiArtifactCard
title: AiArtifactCard
summary: The compact card a reply shows for an artifact it made, such as "Q3 summary · Document · v3", that opens the artifact.
whenToUse: In an assistant reply, for each artifact part of the message: a document, code, a table, a chart, an image or a web page the reply produced.
whenNotToUse: For a file attached by a person use a file card. For a link to a web page the reply cited use a source or citation component.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiArtifactCard(title: String, kind: MonarchAiArtifactKind, version: Int, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, active: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, kindLabel: String? = null, versionLabel: String? = null, actionLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchAiArtifactCard(part: MonarchAiArtifactPart, onOpen: (MonarchAiArtifactPart) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, active: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: kind
options.description: What the artifact is, which selects the kind name.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Called when the card is activated. Open the artifact here.

options.name: part
options.description: The artifact part of a message, from MonarchAiConversation.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Called with the part when the card is activated.

options.name: active
options.description: Whether the artifact is the one currently on show.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the card can be activated.

options.name: icon
options.description: The kind's icon in a tile before the text. Monarch bundles no icons; without one there is no tile.

options.name: trailingIcon
options.description: An icon after the action, such as a chevron. Decorative.

options.name: kindLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in name of the kind.

options.name: versionLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "v3" shown and "version 3" read. An empty string hides it.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions.

states.name: resting
states.description: A surface-coloured card with the default border; the action text is in the strong AI color.

states.name: active
states.description: The subtle AI fill, a 2dp AI border, "Showing" in place of "Open", and the selected state.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The subtle background and border and the disabled text color.

appearance: A card with 12dp corners. At rest the surface role with the default border; active, the subtle AI fill with a 2dp AI border. The title is default text, the kind and version line muted text, the action the strong AI role. The optional icon tile is the subtle AI fill with the strong AI color.
platformNotes: The web takes the artifact part of the conversation model; Android offers that overload and one that takes the title, kind and version, as iOS does. The parity map names MonarchCard; a card has no pressed, active or disabled colors, so the card is a Material 3 Surface with an onClick, drawn with MonarchCard's radius and border. The web draws its own kind glyphs and a chevron; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so both are slots. The web's 28rem maximum width has no Monarch token on Android; constrain the width with the modifier. The web's hover state has no counterpart on touch.
accessibility: One button whose content description reads the title, the kind, the version in words, the description and the action.
The artifact on show has the selected state, reads "Showing" and has a heavier border, not color alone.
The icon and the trailing icon are inside cleared semantics and never read.
The card is at least 48dp high and its touch target at least 48dp.
Text grows with the font size setting and wraps; nothing is truncated.
A focus ring follows the card's shape for keyboard focus.
edgeCases: A long title wraps; nothing is truncated.
An empty versionLabel removes the version from the visible line and from what TalkBack reads.
The card does not open anything itself; onClick or onOpen does.

examples.title: Kinds
examples.template:
Column(
    modifier = Modifier.widthIn(max = 448.dp),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2),
) {
    MonarchAiArtifactCard(
        title = {{parts.0.title}},
        kind = MonarchAiArtifactKind.{{parts.0.kind|pascal}},
        version = {{parts.0.version}},
        onClick = {},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Document, contentDescription = null) },
        trailingIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
    )
    MonarchAiArtifactCard(
        title = {{parts.1.title}},
        kind = MonarchAiArtifactKind.{{parts.1.kind|pascal}},
        version = {{parts.1.version}},
        onClick = {},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Code, contentDescription = null) },
        trailingIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
    )
    MonarchAiArtifactCard(
        title = {{parts.2.title}},
        kind = MonarchAiArtifactKind.{{parts.2.kind|pascal}},
        version = {{parts.2.version}},
        onClick = {},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Globe, contentDescription = null) },
        trailingIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
    )
}
